changelog: Material 3 Expressive UI: spring-physics motion (VfSprings v3.1), emphasized typography, surface-container ladders, and unified WorkspaceInsets
Motion Lab (Alpha): frame interpolation and 2x/4x FPS synthesis powered by native optical flow (DIS / Farnebäck)
Document Scanner: real-time EMA QuadStabilizer, per-page exposure/contrast/saturation Adjust dialog, and progressive PDF export
Background Remover: direct MediaStore gallery exports (Pictures/VeilFrame) with persistent Library synchronization
AI Upscaler: streaming band processing for huge images, dynamic memory governor (6–16 GB devices), Lanczos-3 precomputed kernels, and fail-closed quantized-model pipeline (FP16/INT8)
CV Reliability: Phase B6 cancellation checkpoints across all computer vision primitives and OpenCV 4.14.0 + WeChatQRCode in-tree SDK
